mintAuthority.summary: sUSDai's canonical Arbitrum vault mints shares only against USDai deposited at the current share price. Its adapter-only return mint is bounded by sUSDai previously burned outbound and recorded as bridgedSupply. The transparent proxy can change those constraints only through a 48-hour DVNTimelock whose sole proposer and canceller is a 3-of-3 Safe. Satellite OToken and LayerZero controls are reviewed separately in the bridge-risk module.

controls.label: sUSDai canonical USDai-backed vault
controls.capDescription: Canonical deposit and mint calls issue shares only after calculating the current USDai-denominated share price and pulling the matching USDai into the vault. Adapter-only return minting decrements bridgedSupply and therefore cannot exceed sUSDai previously burned outbound under the current implementation.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495160622, the proxy resolved to source-verified StakedUSDai implementation 0x88a233b8746da5dfd9c5e82c8a9f9f91b737198b, asset() returned USDai 0x0A1a1A107E45b7Ced86833863f482BC5f4ed82EF, and paused() was false. Verified source mints deposit shares only after computing the USDai amount and pulling it into the vault. The adapter-only mint(address,uint256) path decrements bridgedSupply, so an amount above previously burned outbound supply underflows and reverts. Satellite OToken role authority is excluded here and retained in bridgeRouteRisk.

controls.label: sUSDai Arbitrum ProxyAdmin timelock
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495160622, the sUSDai EIP-1967 admin slot resolved to ProxyAdmin 0x0b3296b6f50611b28d466a6d5a49754dad4d8d9f, ProxyAdmin.owner() returned DVNTimelock 0x0eea1ee08611ff4a4e83bfe3916712751995639b, and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. A completed timelocked upgrade can replace the deposit-bound mint logic, so the economic cap is raiseable rather than immutable.

controls.label: sUSDai Arbitrum timelock proposer Safe
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495160622, this Safe remained the DVNTimelock's sole proposer and canceller and also held executor authority. Safe reads returned the same three owners, threshold 3, and one enabled Zodiac Delay module at 0x0f01365579158FBe041FAe1c7b7005E622d396c4. The Safe can schedule a mint-logic upgrade, but execution remains subject to the downstream 172800-second DVNTimelock delay.

review.evidence: Canonical-chain review at Arbitrum block 495160622 (2026-08-16T13:58:25Z): sUSDai proxy 0x0b2b2b2076d95dda7817e785989fe353fe955ef9 resolved to source-verified implementation 0x88a233b8746da5dfd9c5e82c8a9f9f91b737198b and ProxyAdmin 0x0b3296b6f50611b28d466a6d5a49754dad4d8d9f. Native deposit issuance pulled USDai into the vault at the current share price. The contract reported 322311292.875311971 totalShares, defined as local totalSupply plus bridgedSupply plus pending redemption shares, against 356350865.420782685 USDai-denominated totalAssets; depositSharePrice was 1.105610969006254479. This continuously reconciles the complete canonical share liability to the vault's on-chain asset accounting. Adapter return minting is bounded by previously recorded outbound burns. The ProxyAdmin owner remained the 172800-second DVNTimelock; its sole proposer and canceller remained the reviewed 3-of-3 Safe. Current issuance constraints can therefore be replaced only after the governed delay, supporting raiseable economic-cap semantics and a partially bounded admin posture. The inherited USDai review remains relevant to the vault's deposited base asset. Satellite OToken role administration and LayerZero message-mint exposure are intentionally excluded from Mint Authority and retained in bridgeRouteRisk, preventing the same bridge control from being assessed in both modules. No named prudential regulator supervises USD.AI.
